note: Printable sticker gallery manifest. Add a new template by dropping a high-res PNG in assets/stickers/ and appending an entry here. 'image' is the print master AND the preview (scaled by CSS). Keep masters >= 1200px on the long edge so QR codes stay crisp at 4 in / 300 DPI. Optional 'previewScale' (0-1) shrinks a card's preview only (not the print output) so edge-to-edge square art matches the footprint of the portrait posters.
